summary: This bill requires U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Protection (CBP) officers to undergo annual training, use body-worn and dashboard cameras, clearly display identification, and generally prohibits immigration enforcement actions in sensitive locations like schools and hospitals, while also requiring citizenship verification before arrest and notification of local law enforcement before operations.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses immigration enforcement by setting standards for ICE officers, including training, use of cameras, identification, and restrictions on enforcement actions in 'sensitive locations.' It also prohibits the deportation of U.S. citizens. These provisions aim to regulate and, in some cases, restrict the methods and scope of immigration enforcement, which leans towards a less aggressive enforcement posture.
